name: Bubble
summary: No-code platform for building and shipping web and mobile apps, from an AI prompt or a visual editor.
description: Bubble is a no-code app builder: build with AI when you want speed or edit visually when you want precision, adding database, workflow logic, API integrations and privacy rules. It offers a free plan, app templates, plugins, a showcase gallery and an academy.
contains: free plan with no credit card required
AI app generation from a text prompt
visual editing of design, database, logic, API integrations and privacy rules
template marketplace to buy and sell app templates
